provenance.quote: Shall Option B, providing for the appointment of the clerk by the town board, be adopted for the government of the town?

sources.quote:
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, that the Town Board of Clearwater
Township, Wright County, Minnesota does hereby designate that the Township Clerk
shall hereafter be appointed by the Town Board, provided that the electors vote to
authorize the adoption of said Option B at the November 3, 2026 Town election.

measures.questionText: Shall Option B, providing for the appointment of the clerk by the town board, be adopted for the government of the town?

provenance.quote: Shall Option B, providing for the appointment of the clerk by the town board, be adopted for the government of the town?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Changes Clearwater Township’s clerk from an elected office to an office appointed by the Town Board if voters approve Option B.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the Town Board to appoint the township clerk.
measureRecords.noMeans: Keep the township clerk elected rather than adopting appointment through this question.
